title: Microsoft Purview: export DLP and label policy configurations as a ZIP file (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The export behaviour, government-cloud roadmap facts and both portal routes are supported. The default-state field incorrectly classifies this explicitly selected export operation as on rather than user-opt-in. Microsoft's licensing page also contains conflicting sensitivity-label licensing statements that should be acknowledged.

claims.claim: This export operation does not change policies, labels or content and requires someone to select it.
claims.quote:
The exported ZIP file is a read-only, point-in-time snapshot of your policy configuration. It's intended for reference only.
Select Export to zip.

claims.claim: The default state is on.
claims.quote:
defaultState: "on"
Nothing changes until an admin exports; no action is required.
The standard defines user-opt-in as available but each user chooses to use it; Learn says: Select Export to zip.
claims.fix: Set defaultState to "user-opt-in": this is an available export capability that its user explicitly selects, not automatic export or enforcement. The export instructions are at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/purview-policy-export; searches for an export enable/disable switch found none.
